messages:
sanjay: heads up — Borealis reached back, they want an EAP for their new accelerator. NDA ok on their side, asking about a lightweight bench + telemetry integration. thinking 4-week window. anyone object?
marie: can we confirm NDA language? last hw NDA had a weird IP clause. i'll loop legal. cc @olivia for telemetry scope.
olivia: happy to own telemetry. want to avoid heavy hooks. propose: sample logs + perf CSVs, and a tiny agent that ships anonymized metrics via our existing telemetry endpoint. no PII.
adam: marketplace packaging note — if we plan a joint listing later we need an AMI/container artifact spec from them. suggest we require a `marketplace-ready` build as a stretch goal (not blocker for EAP).
sanjay: agreed. main asks from Borealis: 1) quick perf numbers (p99/latency, throughput) 2) model boot time 3) KV cache memory profile 4) crash logs. they asked for an NDA and a sync this week.
marie: legal wants the NDA draft by EOD so we can sign early next week. i'll add a clause that disallows partner press for 45 days after bench completion. ok?
olivia: 45 days is fine. for telemetry, we need these metrics: `tokens/sec`, `p50/p95/p99 latency`, `kv_cache_bytes`, `gpu_util`, `oom_count`. also add a small sampled `input_hash` to help dedupe test runs.
sanjay: here's a tiny perf script i'll share with their infra team — they can run under their CI and paste results:
```
# run synthetic perf
python perf_run.py --model r-instruct-3b --seq 2048 --batch 8 --iters 100 --report csv
```
please add `--kv-probe` to collect cache sizes.
adam: we'll need an internal checklist for marketplace metadata: icon, short/long description, pricing tiers, and a privacy blurb for telemetry. sara from marketing should be in the loop.
partner_ops_bot: ACTION: created eap-onboard checklist ticket #EAP-782 in Partnerships board (assignee: sanjay). Reminder: sync deadline 3 days from thread_ts.
marie: also flag SI integration — Borealis wants to validate performance with our partner integrator, Whitecap Systems. need a contact and runway for a joint test next month.
olivia: proposing minimal agent: HTTPS POST to `https://telemetry.redwood.ai/eap` with HMAC header. i'll draft schema and sample payload.
sanjay: timeline proposal: week 0 NDA + environment exchange; week 1 bench + telemetry run; week 2 iterate on infra issues; week 3 SI joint test; week 4 analysis + signoff. joint announcement earliest week 6.
adam: fine. marketing hold on announcement until we have results and signed coop MOU.
marie: legal/ops note: require a rollback clause in the MOU for any customer-impacting regressions.
olivia: also let's capture a small eval set for quality regression checks — 50 prompts that exercise long-context behavior. i'll own that.
sanjay: ok owners: NDA (marie) by Fri EOD, telemetry schema (olivia) by Tue, marketplace spec (adam) by next Wed, runbook & bench script (sanjay) by Tue, SI contact intro (marie) by Mon.
adam: added marketing + legal to the ticket.
marie: signing off for today, will post NDA draft in the ticket when ready.
partner_ops_bot: REMINDER: next sync scheduled in 72 hours.
